title: Rezan Has Museum

buildingCutout.basis: The 14-point native C Block wing opposite Cibali T5 station.

terrainReference.basis: Freeze original street-side elevation at the frontage opposite the operator-identified tram stop, just outside the traced C Block wall.

mapIdentity.provider: Original OpenStreetMap building outlines and tram stop, interpreted with the university handbook’s identification of the museum in C Block and the museum’s statement that the entrance is opposite Cibali station.
mapIdentity.scope: Exact 14-point OSM building way 525964000. Campus directory places the museum in the Cibali factory C Block and the operator locates its main door opposite the Cibali T5 stop on the Golden Horn side.

note: The frozen original elevation controls the street entrance and foundation. The university documents retained red brick and tall arched windows. The lower museum masonry photo corroborates mixed brick and rubble fabric. Three visible factory storeys, roof shape and door positions are estimated exterior sections.
